headline: Cool fall Monday on Table Rock — crisp air and light winds
lede: Monday, October 19, 2026 delivers pleasant fall weather with a high near 68°F and low in the mid-40s. Clear to partly cloudy skies and zero rain chance make it a perfect first-timer day for lake activities, a show, or exploring the Branson Landing.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Fall Cruise or Paddle
featured.where: Table Rock Lake near Notch Lane and Indian Point
featured.why: Cooler water temperatures improve fishing bite for bass, crappie and trout while comfortable air temps and light winds create ideal sightseeing conditions. Morning is best before any afternoon breeze.

plan.title: Early fishing or sunrise paddle
plan.detail: Cool fall mornings bring active fish near main lake points and coves. Launch from Indian Point or rent a kayak for a peaceful start. Verify current lake levels locally.

plan.title: Matinee show or Branson Landing stroll
plan.detail: Enjoy one of the popular afternoon performances on the Strip or walk the scenic boardwalk at the Landing. Temperatures stay comfortable for outdoor exploration.

plan.title: Fountain show and lakeside dinner
plan.detail: End your day with the spectacular Branson Landing fountain and light show followed by dinner with a view. Confirm current showtimes and restaurant hours locally.

indoor.name: WonderWorks Branson

indoor.name: Ripley's Believe It or Not!
indoor.detail: Climate-controlled exhibits of oddities, illusions, and interactive zones perfect for families.

indoor.name: Hollywood Wax Museum
indoor.detail: Life-like celebrity figures and fun interactive displays — a Branson classic that stays comfortable indoors.
